pipeline.stage_a_role: Coarse acquisition and loss recovery detector. Runs on initial frame or when Stage B presence < threshold.
pipeline.stage_b_role: Continuous fine perception: 16 keypoints, 6D continuous rotation, relative scale, dual masks, presence, and next ROI. Runs every frame per foot on rotation-normalized 224x224 crop.
pipeline.tracking_boundary: Perception outputs raw candidates and per-frame crop estimates. The AR SDK owns temporal association, persistent track IDs, PnP, and Three.js scene integration.

primary_resolution.layout: Channel-major: 18 rows x 2100 anchors at 320x320 letterbox resolution

fallback_resolution.layout: Channel-major: 18 rows x 1344 anchors at 256x256 resolution

nms_rules.decoder_nms: Independent per-class NMS (left_foot and right_foot processed independently). NO cross-class suppression. Preserves both feet during overlap and crossing.

stage-a-320-fp16.onnx.description: WebGPU-optimized FP16 model with genuine float16 weights

stage-a-256-int8.onnx.description: WASM single-thread fallback quantized to INT8

input.name: crop
input.description: Square rotation-normalized crop centered on target foot, no letterbox padding

keypoints.description: Crop-normalized (x, y, v) in range [0, 1] for all 16 points in frozen order

rotation.description: Continuous 6-D rotation (first 2 columns of 3x3 rotation matrix). Recovered via Gram-Schmidt in decoder.

relative_scale.description: Dimensionless foot length and width relative to canonical template (1.0 = 265mm x 98mm)

sigma.description: Per-keypoint positional uncertainty sigma in crop-normalized coordinates

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence [0, 1] derived via baked smoothstep: 1 - smoothstep(0.01, 0.08, sigma) * (1 - v)

presence.description: Probability [0, 1] that target foot is actively present inside this crop (sigmoid in-graph)

next_roi.description: (cx, cy, w, h, theta) in current crop-normalized coordinates [0, 1], ready for affine composition by AR SDK

foot_mask.description: Sigmoid probability mask of target foot/shoe surface in-graph

foreground_mask.description: Sigmoid probability mask of occluding foreground (garments, cuffs, other foot) in-graph

depth_order.description: Confidence [0, 1] that detected foreground/other foot is in front of target foot (sigmoid in-graph)

stage-b-224-fp32.onnx.description: Primary landmark/pose model in FP32 precision

stage-b-224-fp16.onnx.description: WebGPU-optimized FP16 model with genuine float16 weights

stage-b-224-int8.onnx.description: WASM single-thread fallback quantized to INT8

visibility_labels.0: Not labeled or outside frame. Excluded from keypoint loss.
visibility_labels.1: Anatomically present but occluded/covered. Position supervised, visibility target negative.
visibility_labels.2: Visible and unoccluded. Visibility target positive.
